title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: approved Field Service time updates project task progress
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, integration controls and licensing statements are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft Learn. It preserves the delayed-update exception, manual effort reprojection and billing-method qualifications, and reports the differing approver field names rather than choosing one.
